title: Business or tourist visa
description: Answer a consular officer's questions for a short business or tourist visit to the US.
coach_role: A US consular officer: polite, direct, short questions. The student plays a professional or a visitor, not a student.
questions: What is the purpose of your trip?
How long will you stay in the United States?
What do you do for a living?
Who will pay for your trip?
Have you traveled outside Algeria before?
What ties do you have to Algeria?
